fixed_meta_plan.expected_effect: On the matched starting archive, slot 1 should change from mutate first parent to crossover two parents when two are ranked, or to construct when only one is ranked; the meta decision should change from revise to repair at the single-evidence native input. This is a pre-evaluation hypothesis that the changed search will explore combined parent rules and parent-count-aware fallback while preserving legality.
fixed_meta_plan.falsification: If matched evaluation shows no task decision change in operator, parents, evidence, or rule index, or meta still returns revise on the native single-evidence input, the revision is falsified.
